About Me

Explore My
Data Journey

I'm an aspiring Data Analyst based in Tirupati, India, with hands-on internship experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions — from raw data wrangling to polished executive dashboards.

I enjoy untangling messy datasets, finding the story inside the numbers, and translating that into visuals that make decisions easier. Whether it's attrition analysis or a sales pipeline tracker, I focus on outputs that are technically sound and genuinely useful.

I hold a BCA from Gate Degree & PG College (affiliated with Sri Venkateshwara University) and a certified Data Analyst credential from ExcelR Solutions.
